skill.name: copywriter
skill.description: Write high-converting, punchy, and professional copy for landing pages, emails, and marketing materials.
skill.summary: Draft concise marketing copy for landing pages, emails, CTAs, and product messaging.
skill.author: AayushBaniya2006

security_audit.summary: The static findings are false positives caused by ordinary marketing language and copywriting examples. I found no evidence of executable networking, system reconnaissance, data exfiltration, or prompt injection in the reviewed files.

static_findings.snippet: - **Scale**: Built to handle millions of requests.
- **Human**: Write like you speak. Avoid jargon. Be approachable but professional.

finding_verdicts.reason: The flagged word appears in the phrase "millions of requests," which describes product scale in marketing copy. There is no Python library import, network call, or executable code.
The cited lines introduce a value proposition grid for copy examples. They do not instruct system probing, host discovery, or any reconnaissance activity.
The line is an editing checklist that asks whether weak marketing terms were removed. It contains no command, system query, or request for environment information.
The line defines a human writing tone for copywriting output. It does not request identity discovery, system metadata, or execution of reconnaissance commands.

content.value_statement: Teams often need persuasive copy that is clear, concise, and conversion focused. This skill drafts and improves landing pages, emails, CTAs, and product messaging.
actual_capabilities: Drafts three copy variations with safe, bold, and direct angles.
Creates hero sections with concise headlines, subheaders, and CTAs.
Improves weak copy by trimming filler and strengthening verbs.
Formats copy with Markdown headers, bold text, and scannable lists.
Uses benefit-led messaging for landing pages, emails, and marketing materials.
limitations: Does not verify claims, metrics, or legal compliance.
Does not create brand strategy without user-provided context.
Does not run market research or competitor analysis.
May need human review for regulated industries.

use_cases.title: Launch Page Copy
use_cases.description: Create a sharp hero section, value grid, and CTA for a new product page.

use_cases.title: Email Campaign Drafting
use_cases.description: Turn campaign goals into concise subject lines, body copy, and conversion-focused calls to action.

use_cases.title: Product Messaging Cleanup
use_cases.description: Rewrite dense feature descriptions into simple benefit-led copy for buyers and users.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Hero Section
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a landing page opening.
prompt_templates.prompt: Write a landing page hero for [product]. Audience: [audience]. Goal: [action]. Include one headline, one subheader, and one CTA.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Existing Copy
prompt_templates.scenario: Rewrite unclear or generic marketing text.
prompt_templates.prompt: Improve this copy for clarity and conversion: [paste copy]. Keep the meaning. Make it shorter, more direct, and benefit focused.

prompt_templates.title: Create Three Angles
prompt_templates.scenario: Compare safe, bold, and direct messaging options.
prompt_templates.prompt: Write three versions of copy for [offer]. Use safe, bold, and direct angles. Explain the best use case for each version.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Messaging Set
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for coordinated campaign assets.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a messaging set for [product] targeting [audience]. Include a hero, value props, feature blocks, email copy, and CTAs.

output_examples.input: Write a hero section for a SaaS deployment tool.
output_examples.output: Deploy apps in minutes. Skip setup delays with a production-ready workflow for modern teams. CTA: Start deploying.

output_examples.input: Improve: Our platform uses advanced technology to help teams collaborate better.
output_examples.output: Bring every project into focus. Give your team one clear place to plan, share, and move work forward.

output_examples.input: Create CTA options for a free trial.

best_practices: Provide the audience, goal, product, and desired action before asking for copy.
Include proof points, constraints, and claims that are approved for use.
Review each draft for accuracy, brand fit, and legal requirements.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for copy without naming the audience or conversion goal.
Do not publish generated metrics or claims without verification.
Do not keep vague adjectives when a concrete benefit is available.

faq.question: What does this skill write?
faq.answer: It writes landing page sections, emails, CTAs, feature blocks, and product messaging.

faq.question: Can it rewrite existing copy?
faq.answer: Yes. It can shorten text, improve clarity, and make benefits easier to understand.

faq.question: Does it check facts?
faq.answer: No. You must verify claims, numbers, customer names, and compliance requirements.

faq.question: What context should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the audience, product, offer, goal, tone, and any approved proof points.

faq.question: Can it create multiple options?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow asks for safe, bold, and direct variations.

faq.question: Is it suitable for regulated industries?
faq.answer: It can draft copy, but regulated content needs expert and legal review before publication.
